subject: BC/Resilience Evidence Request — First Corner Bank
messages:
From: Procurement <procurement@firstcornerbank.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: David Alvarez <david.alvarez@firstcornerbank.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 08:05:00 -0400
Subject: Request for BC/IT Audit Evidence — Redwood Inference

Hi Karthik,

First Corner Bank is performing a vendor resilience and audit evidence review as part of our 2025 third‑party risk cycle. We are requesting the following items for Redwood Inference to support our FFIEC‑style assessment: 

1) SOC 2 Type II report for the most recent 12 month period (redacted acceptable)
2) Business continuity / disaster recovery executive summary and most recent DR exercise results
3) RTO / RPO targets for hosted API and Dedicated deployments and any measured metrics from last 12 months
4) Description of failover topology (regions, cross‑region replication, regional latency implications)
5) Audit log retention policy and sample log-schema (redacted)
6) Evidence of penetration test or vulnerability assessment and remediation timelines
7) Control ownership for change management and emergency change rollback procedures

Can you confirm whether the materials above can be provided via our secure vendor portal or if you prefer to share via a Redwood secure share? Also provide an estimated delivery date for an initial evidence package and a point of contact for any technical follow‑up.

Thanks,

Procurement Team
Vendor Risk Management
First Corner Bank

[Attachment: Vendor_Risk_Form_FCB.pdf (fillable PDF)]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement <procurement@firstcornerbank.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for BC/IT Audit Evidence — Redwood Inference

Hi — thanks for the clear list, and apologies for the brief delay. We can provide an initial evidence package and work with your vendor portal. High level timeline and owners below: 

- SOC 2 Type II (redacted): Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.ai) — will provide redacted PDF and index
- DR exercise + runbook excerpt: Rishi Malhotra (rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai) — executive summary attached
- RTO/RPO and failover topology: Neha Kapoor (neha_kapoor@redwood.ai) — will include measured latency/soak metrics
- Audit logs & retention policy: Security team — delivering redacted samples
- Pen test summary & change control evidence: will include remediation timeline and ticket references

We will upload a consolidated evidence bundle to your portal if you share the upload instructions (ticket or portal link). Alternatively I can share a secure Drive collection — see temporary link below.

Proposed delivery: initial package by EOD Monday, Aug 18 (ET). If you need faster delivery of any single item, let us know which one and we’ll prioritize.

Point of contact for technical follow up: Neha Kapoor (neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, +1 415 555 0198).

Attachments: evidence-index.csv (index of files to follow)

Thanks,

Karthik Iyer
Senior Director, Customer Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

[Attachment stub: evidence-index.csv]

- SOC2-TypeII-report.pdf (PDF, redacted)
- DR-Exercise-2024-executive-summary.pdf

We will include a short encryption summary doc in the portal.

Neha (neha_kapoor@redwood.ai) is confirmed as the technical POC and available Aug 26, 11:00 AM ET for the 30‑minute call. Please send the calendar invite.

Thanks,

Redwood Inference
